summary: Repaired T5 reviewer blocker by changing Admin server event-store publishing from a single-bus closure guard to one push wrapper with a registered bus set and per-server stop cleanup; added regression coverage for reused eventStore across two Admin servers.
notes: Kept changes within T5 owns files; did not modify src/admin/event-store.js, src/api/v1/events-routes.js, or src/app/bootstrap.js.
Event publication is attached in createAdminServer by wrapping eventStore.events.push once and storing a non-enumerable __walkerEventBusPublisher with registered bus reference counts.

Each createAdminServer instance registers its eventBus with the shared publisher; stop() detaches the current bus both for started and never-started servers, so stopped servers do not receive later recordEvent pushes.

Added test/events-websocket.test.js regression coverage that reuses one eventStore for two Admin servers, verifies the second server WebSocket receives a new event, then verifies the stopped second bus no longer receives later events while the first remains active.
The cross-task CLI usage assertion was synced after T4 init wiring; current full npm run check passes.

traceability.json was re-read and left unchanged because existing T5 mappings already include test/event-bus.test.js, test/events-websocket.test.js, test/admin-server.test.js, and the T5 evidence receipt without removing other task mappings.
